tests.name: Documentation full aggregate
tests.details: Windows denied the project-doc-site symlink fixture with EPERM; every other documentation gate passed.

acceptance: One generated 13-step corpus owns pair, connect, describe, list, open, history, follow, prompt, stream, approval, cancel, reconnect, and revoke for all three drivers.
The TypeScript reference driver completed all 13 steps against the real shipped Host composition on clean sourceHead b3d3a9165803f5e416e0c1cb65a3956b3a6c16a3.
The harness boots the shipped base plus desktop composition and uses real TLS, signed requests, target and decoy Sessions, Approval, reconnect, and revocation.
Reconnect requires interrupt-active-streams, exactly one follow replacement, exactly one Remote Event replacement, an authoritative snapshot, and authoritative clientId refresh.

Native drivers write only candidate evidence below an isolated DSH_HOME; the Host independently validates Approval, revocation, corpus identity, source identity, and clean stable input before atomic publication.
Setup failure, cleanup deadline, event-loop blocking, and real Vitest timeout paths retain or replace evidence with sanitized FAIL and cannot publish PASS.
Platform workflows upload lane-specific evidence and source metadata without treating source inspection as native runtime success.
knownLimitations: The TypeScript reference lane is E3 evidence only; no Host-to-Swift or Host-to-Kotlin runtime PASS is claimed, so G1-E2E and Gate 1 remain open.
Windows cannot execute the Swift native lane because Swift/Xcode is unavailable.
Windows cannot execute the Gradle-owned Kotlin native lane because Gradle is unavailable.
The full documentation aggregate is 31/32 because Windows denies the symlink escape fixture with EPERM; no repository documentation drift was reported.

notExecuted.details: No Swift toolchain or Xcode is installed on the Windows execution host.
Gradle is unavailable on the Windows execution host; the native driver belongs to the pure-JVM core module.
